# FTIEntanglementSpectrum

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIEntanglementSpectrum`

```text
FQHETopInsulatorEntanglementSpectrum, version 0.01

Usage: FQHETopInsulatorEntanglementSpectrum [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --density-matrix : file containing the reduced density matrix
    -n, --nbr-particles : number of particles in the A part (default value = 0)
    -o, --output : output name for the entanglement spectrum (default name replace density-matrix full.parent extension with la_x_na_y.entspec)
    -e, --eigenvalue-error : lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eigenvalue (default value = 1e-14)
    --xi-error : minus log of the lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eigenvalue (o if error control relies on the eigenvalue-error option) (default value = 0)
    --show-minmaxkya : show minimum an maximum Ky value that can be reached
    --show-counting : show degeneracy counting for each Ky value
    --show-countingSz : show degeneracy counting for each sz value (in decoupled mode)
    --particle-entanglement : compute particle entanglement spectrum
    --ky-periodic : set the periodicity for for the ky momentum (0 if non-periodic ) (default value = 0)
    --3d : consider a 3d model instead of a 2d model
    --decoupled : assume that the FTI states are made of two decoupled FCI copies
    --Wannier : use Wannier basis
    --Wannier-block-diagonal : use 'block diagonal' Wannier basis 
    --real-space : consider a model written in real space basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
